name: type-focused-search
description: Type Settings into an already focused search field and press Enter. Does not open or navigate to search.
precondition: The intended search field is focused and empty, and the on-screen keyboard is visible.

name: search-calendar
description: Replace an already focused Spotlight search query with Calendar; do not open any result
precondition: Spotlight search field is visibly focused with its on-screen keyboard showing
